description: This file contains unit tests for verifying the parsing of launch agent plist files in the GatewayLaunchAgentManager component. It tests the ability to correctly parse arguments, environment variables, and handle missing fields.

classes.name: GatewayLaunchAgentManagerTests
classes.description: A struct containing unit test functions for testing the parsing of launch agent plist files.

methods.name: `launch agent plist snapshot parses args and env`
methods.description: Tests that the plist snapshot correctly parses program arguments and environment variables from a properly formatted plist.

methods.name: `launch agent plist snapshot allows missing bind`
methods.description: Tests that the plist snapshot correctly handles missing optional fields such as the bind address.
